roadmap.title: Story, scanning and skills
roadmap.description: Play the campaign, scan every animal and plant, touch saplings, bellsprigs and tarsyu flowers, and spend skill points. Do not clear Kame'tire contributions before the story takes you into the third region.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and clearing the RDA
roadmap.description: After the story, gather the Upper Plains and Clouded Forest collectibles, finish the clan contribution chains and the Steady Wings quest, then destroy all 57 RDA buildings for 100% air quality.

roadmap.title: The Sky Breaker DLC
roadmap.description: Play the Sky Breaker story, activate the four research points, and craft a legendary item.

roadmap.title: Secrets of the Spires DLC
roadmap.description: Play the Spires story, buy all Memories of the Sky Hunter skills inside the DLC, and smash twenty objects with Ikran Smash.

roadmap.title: From the Ashes DLC
roadmap.description: Start the expansion by importing a base-game save, lose the opening ikran race, then clear the story, bases, Zeykoma fruit and gear sets while working toward 50 One Shot AMP kills.

achievements.summary: Complete the main campaign of Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora.

steps.text: Finish the last main quest, @loc{Last Strike}.

achievements.sortReason: Fight at Gossamer Lakes once leveled.
achievements.summary: Defeat a non-feral @enemy{thanator}.

guide.context: A non-feral thanator turns the screen edges white and you hear a heartbeat. You cannot call your ikran while it stalks you. It is level 20, so be level 16 or higher.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Gossamer Lakes} in @loc{Kinglor Forest}. Walk toward the louder heartbeat until the thanator attacks.
Defeat it. Feral thanators seen in missions do not count.

achievements.summary: Unlock three Ancestor Skills.

guide.context: The flowers appear on the map after you touch the first one in the quest @loc{Songs of the Ancestor}. Twelve exist, and any three count. The flying mount from @loc{Take Flight} makes them easier to reach.

steps.text: Touch any three red @item{tarsyu flowers}. Each one gives one Ancestor Skill.

achievements.sortReason: Saplings are everywhere; collect during play.
achievements.summary: Touch 20 @item{tarsyu saplings}.

guide.context: Each sapling also gives a skill point, so touching extra ones helps your skill trees.

steps.text: Touch @item{tarsyu saplings} as you travel until you have touched 20. Some are inside caves.

achievements.sortReason: Bellsprigs are everywhere; collect during play.
achievements.summary: Touch 20 @item{bellsprigs}.

guide.context: There are many more than 20. Cleared large RDA bases hold about 3 each. Each one gives a health bonus.

steps.text: Touch @item{bellsprigs} as you travel until you have touched 20.

achievements.sortReason: Needs the ikran and the Upper Plains.
achievements.summary: Collect all 9 windswept kites in the Upper Plains.

guide.context: Kites from the DLCs do not count.

steps.text: Fly your ikran to the kites high in the mountains of the @loc{Upper Plains} and collect all 9.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Becoming.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Becoming}, Main Quest 5.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Pushing Back.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Pushing Back}, Main Quest 13.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Combined Forces.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Combined Forces}, Main Quest 19.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Revelations.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Revelations}, Main Quest 27.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Rising Pressure.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Rising Pressure}, Main Quest 29.

achievements.summary: Collect all 9 windswept dolls in the Clouded Forest.

steps.text: Search the @loc{Clouded Forest} for dolls inside tree stumps, hollow trunks, and sometimes rocks, cliffs, or caves. Collect all 9.

achievements.summary: Complete all 9 recon retrievals at the Data Collectors.

guide.context: Wind turbines are tall and easy to spot. Progress shows in the journal.

steps.text: At each of the 9 @loc{Data Collector} stations, use the computer to start the retrieval.
Use your scanner to find the station's three sensors. The scan crosshair shrinks as you get close to a sensor.
Activate all three sensors. Repeat at every station.

achievements.description: Unlock 20 Hunter's Guide entries for gatherable wildlife.
achievements.summary: Add 20 gatherable animals to the Hunter's Guide.

steps.text: Hold the @mechanic{Na'vi senses} key, then press the inspect key on animals you can gather. Harvesting an animal also adds its entry.
Check Hunter's Guide, type Wildlife (gatherable), until it shows 20.

achievements.description: Unlock 30 Hunter's Guide entries for gatherable plants.
achievements.summary: Add 30 gatherable plants to the Hunter's Guide.

steps.text: Hold the @mechanic{Na'vi senses} key, then press the inspect key on plants you can gather. Harvesting a plant also adds its entry.
Check Hunter's Guide, type Flora (gatherable), until it shows 30.

achievements.summary: Collect 30 audio logs.

guide.context: About 50 exist, so you can skip some.

steps.text: Collect audio logs from shelters, field labs, and destroyed RDA bases until the journal's Audio Logs page shows 30.

achievements.sortReason: Finish one tree plus its apex challenge.
achievements.summary: Unlock an Apex Skill.

guide.context: Only one Apex Skill is needed. Skill points come from quests, tarsyu flowers, and tarsyu saplings.

steps.text: Buy every skill in one skill tree.
Finish the apex challenge for that tree. Its requirement is in the quest tab and on the apex skill's tooltip.

achievements.sortReason: Small installations; also needed for air quality.
achievements.summary: Defeat 10 RDA installations.

guide.context: Installations have few guards, no turrets, and no reinforcements. All 35 are needed later for @item{Reclaim Pandora}.

steps.text: Destroy 10 @loc{RDA installations}. These are the smallest RDA sites and look like drills.

achievements.sortReason: Mid-size outposts; also needed for air quality.
achievements.summary: Defeat five RDA outposts.

guide.context: All 19 outposts are needed later for @item{Reclaim Pandora}.

steps.text: Clear every objective at five @loc{RDA outposts}. These are mid-size, fortress-like sites.

achievements.summary: Collect 30 notes.

guide.context: About 56 exist, so you can skip some.

steps.text: Collect notes from shelters, field labs, and destroyed RDA bases until the journal's Notes page shows 30.

achievements.description: Unlock three recipes for specialty dishes.
achievements.sortReason: Specialty recipes from quests and baskets.
achievements.summary: Unlock three specialty dish recipes.

guide.context: Only entries under Specialties count. Regular recipes do not. Open every wicker basket you pass.

steps.text: Get specialty recipes from quest rewards, wicker baskets, and NPCs.
Open a cooking station and look at its Specialties list. It must show three recipes.

achievements.description: Craft a weapon or gear piece of 'superior' rarity or higher.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a superior blueprint and materials.
achievements.summary: Craft one weapon or armor item that is superior rarity or better.

steps.text: Talk to a clan merchant, open the Designs tab, and take every free blueprint. One merchant is at @loc{The Hollows} in @loc{Stone Cloud Valley}.
At a workbench, choose a superior (purple) or better recipe. Pin its missing materials and track them on the map.
Craft the item. It needs superior-quality materials.

achievements.displayName: Father and Son in the Stars
achievements.summary: Collect all 11 treasure hunt comic pages.

guide.context: Page 9 may not have a task. Find it with a map and the hunt continues.

steps.text: Finish the quest @loc{Finding Home} to start the treasure hunt.
Activate the computer terminals in overgrown trailers. Each of the first 10 gives a task that leads to one page.
After page 10, follow the final task to page 11.

achievements.description: Reach an air quality level of 100%.
achievements.sortReason: Clear all 57 RDA buildings after the story.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% air quality on Pandora.

guide.context: Start the quest @loc{Cleaning the Air} to see air quality at Resistance HQ.

steps.text: Destroy all 57 RDA sites: 35 installations, 19 outposts, and 3 bases. Polluted areas show brown on the map.
Destroy the @enemy{Omega Drilling Rig} in the story.
Check air quality at Resistance HQ or a field lab, or on the achievement tracker.

achievements.sortReason: Seventeen flutes in the Upper Plains.
achievements.summary: Tune all 17 aeolian wind flutes in the Upper Plains.

guide.context: Flutes from the DLCs do not count.

steps.text: Tune every @item{aeolian wind flute} in the @loc{Upper Plains}. Four are made during the quest @loc{Gulch of Weeping}.

achievements.summary: Complete all 12 Sarentu totem interactions.

guide.context: Totems from the DLCs do not count. In co-op, totems count for the host only.

steps.text: Find each @item{Sarentu totem}.
Stand at its vantage point, a circle of branches on the ground, usually 100 to 170 m away, and look at the totem.

achievements.sortReason: Nine activities; one must be repeated after reset.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Mycelium Network activities in the Clouded Forest.

guide.context: A completed mushroom resets after about a day of real time.

steps.text: At each of the 9 large mushrooms in the @loc{Clouded Forest}, follow its mushroom path and touch the 4 small mushrooms.
After all 9 are done, wait for one to reset, then do it again to make 10.

achievements.description: Follow all the bladewing moths to their nests.
achievements.summary: Follow all 11 bladewing moth trails to their nests.

guide.context: A direhorse or ikran helps you keep up on the long trails in the Upper Plains and the Clouded Forest. Sneakberries from the DLCs do not count.

steps.text: Activate each nest. Moths fly out.
Keep up with the moths until they reach the @item{sneakberry} plant. If you fall behind, the trail fails and you restart it.

achievements.description: Complete Part 3 of the clan community quests.
achievements.sortReason: Three clan contribution chains; save for last.
achievements.summary: Finish the third stage of the community quest chain for each of the three clans: Aranahe, Zeswa, and Kame'tire.

guide.context: Stash gathered items at clan homes to save time. If the Zeswa quests stop at Part 2, complete Zeswa side quests to move on.

steps.text: Touch a community basket at a clan home or camp (a red tent on the map). It asks for a plant, animal part, or cooked meal.
Deliver the item. Use a different basket for each new request. Part 1 needs 3 deliveries, Part 2 needs 5, and Part 3 needs 7.
Do this for all three clans: Aranahe in Kinglor Forest, Zeswa in Upper Plains, and Kame'tire in Clouded Forest.
Do not finish every Kame'tire delivery before the story takes you into the Clouded Forest. Part 3 can get stuck at 0 and block the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the final Steady Wings side quest.
achievements.sortReason: Three-part escort quest; keep the queen calm.
achievements.summary: Finish the third and last part of the Steady Wings side quest.

guide.context: A stress meter tracks the queen. When it is full, she goes back to the tree and that part starts over. Finish the main quest @loc{Displacement} first.

steps.text: Reach the top floor of @loc{Hometree} in @loc{Kinglor Forest}, talk to the quest giver, and interact with the flower behind them to take out the queen moth.
Lead the queen to each waypoint tree. Walk instead of running, and do not jump, swim, fight, or fly.
Return to the same quest giver for Part 2, then Part 3. Finish Part 3.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 skills in each skill tree.
achievements.summary: Unlock three skills in each of the five skill trees.

guide.context: The Rider tree opens after the flying mount in @loc{Take Flight}. Skill points come from quests, tarsyu flowers, and tarsyu saplings. The DLC tree does not count.

steps.text: Spend skill points on three skills in each tree: Survivor, Warrior, Hunter, Maker, and Rider.

achievements.description: Complete the quest The Bitter End.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sky Breaker quest The Bitter End.

steps.text: Finish the last Sky Breaker story quest, @loc{The Bitter End}.

achievements.description: Craft a weapon or gear piece of legendary rarity
achievements.sortReason: Needs an exquisite recipe and materials.
achievements.summary: Craft one weapon or armor item that is legendary rarity.

guide.context: The Sky Breaker DLC adds legendary rarity. The Secrets of the Spires story also has a crafting quest that makes a legendary item.

steps.text: Get an exquisite-tier recipe and exquisite materials. A legendary item needs only one exquisite ingredient. The Ghost Cry Shortbow is a good choice.
Craft it at a workbench.

achievements.sortReason: Four field labs and spare parts.
achievements.summary: Activate all four Resistance Research Points.

guide.context: The stations belong to a DLC quest. They are different from the research points in the base game.

steps.text: Find the four research stations: @loc{Kinglor Wetlands}, @loc{Enduring Woods}, @loc{Rivers Run Plateau}, and @loc{The Crying Vale}.
At each station, turn on the power, answer the call, and put 10 spare parts in the orange box.
The achievement unlocks at the fourth station.

achievements.description: Complete the quest The Sky Breaker.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sky Breaker quest The Sky Breaker.

steps.text: Finish the Sky Breaker story quest @loc{The Sky Breaker}.

achievements.description: Complete the quest When the Zakru Walk.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sky Breaker quest When the Zakru Walk.

steps.text: Finish the Sky Breaker story quest @loc{When the Zakru Walk}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Secrets of the Spires quest Skybound.

steps.text: Finish the story quest @loc{Skybound}.

achievements.description: Complete the quest Into the Mountain.
achievements.summary: Complete the Secrets of the Spires quest Into the Mountain.

steps.text: Finish the story quest @loc{Into the Mountain}.

achievements.description: Complete the quest The Fight for Home.
achievements.summary: Complete the Secrets of the Spires quest The Fight for Home.

steps.text: Finish the story quest @loc{The Fight for Home}.

achievements.description: Unlock all skills in the Memories of the Sky Hunter skill tree.
achievements.sortReason: Buy all eleven Memories skills inside the DLC.
achievements.summary: Buy every skill in the DLC skill tree named Memories of the Sky Hunter.

guide.context: Partly unlocking the tree outside the DLC area can stop the achievement from unlocking.

steps.text: Open the Memories of the Sky Hunter tree in the Secrets of the Spires area and buy all 11 skills. Two come from the main quest and one from a side quest.
Buy them all in one go without going back to the base game.

achievements.description: Smash 20 objects with the Ikran Smash skill.
achievements.summary: Break 20 objects using your ikran's smash attack.

guide.context: About 15 are smashed during the DLC story.

steps.text: Unlock the Ikran Strike skill, then press V while flying your ikran to smash objects.
Smash 20 targets: dawn lanterns, RDA cargo containers, RDA balloons, or branches and small vehicles in caves.

achievements.sortReason: Available at the start of From the Ashes.
achievements.summary: Perform a stealth finisher.

guide.context: The opening mission of From the Ashes sets up an easy one.

steps.text: Sneak up behind an unaware enemy, such as an @enemy{RDA} soldier, and press the finisher prompt.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocked with Warrior Senses on the story path.
achievements.summary: Unlock Warrior Senses in From the Ashes.

guide.context: No side content is needed.

steps.text: Follow the main story of the @loc{Alone} questline until you get Warrior Senses.

achievements.displayName: In Case of Emergency, Break Glass
achievements.description: Eliminate 50 AMP Suits using the "One Shot" skill.
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 @enemy{AMP suits} with the One Shot skill.

guide.context: Choose suits with no cockpit armor when you can. After the story, the Home Tree base still has many AMP suits.

steps.text: Unlock the One Shot skill.
Shoot the pilot in the cockpit with a heavy bow and armor-piercing arrows. The first shot must kill, or the kill does not count.
In the Hunter's Guide, pin AMP suits. Ones with no cockpit armor show purple, not red. Repeat until you have 50.

achievements.description: Find and collect all Zeykoma Fruit.
achievements.sortReason: Eight lilies; the last two open later.
achievements.summary: Find and collect all 8 Zeykoma fruit.

guide.context: Six fruit are available after the quest Blessing. The last two open after the quest The Beast, which opens the Rifts. Each fruit raises maximum health.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit above So'lek's camp
collectibles.method: Look just above the camp and pick the fruit.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit at Dawn's Glade
collectibles.method: Given during a Save Your People questline here.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit above the waterfall
collectibles.method: Go above the waterfall. Scorpion helicopters guard it.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit in Fallen Grotto
collectibles.method: It is in the cave, together with a So'lek stash gear piece.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit near Eagle Echo
collectibles.location: @loc{Silk Woods}, west of Home Tree and northeast of Eagle Echo
collectibles.method: Look for the lily and pick the fruit.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit by Raven Alpha
collectibles.method: Look next to the base and pick the fruit.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit north of Shadow Hollow
collectibles.method: Look for the lily and pick the fruit.

collectibles.name: Zeykoma fruit in the burnt forest
collectibles.location: North of @loc{Nangi's Landing}, east of @loc{Dawn's Glade}
collectibles.method: Defeat the RDA guards, then pick the fruit.

achievements.description: Unlock all gear sets in From the Ashes.
achievements.sortReason: Some sets are in stash caves.
achievements.summary: Collect every armor set added by From the Ashes.

steps.text: Play the story, Save Your People quests, and RDA quests to unlock most sets. Some are upgraded at Chronos or at RDA bases.
For the rest, use the map at So'lek's camp. Cave stashes are marked with large flowers on your map. Reach the stash and loot it.
Hover over any missing set to see where it comes from.

achievements.description: Complete all From the Ashes content to 100%: Save Your People and Sabotage RDA Operations.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% progress on both content lists of the From the Ashes expansion.

steps.text: Finish every entry in the expansion's two progress lists (the people-saving list and the RDA sabotage list), including all RDA bases and outposts.

achievements.sortReason: Pick an old save at the start.
achievements.summary: Import your custom Sarentu from the base game into From the Ashes.

guide.context: Choose the save when you first start the expansion, or restart it.

steps.text: Start From the Ashes and pick an old base-game save when asked.
Play the opening. The achievement unlocks soon after.

achievements.sortReason: Pick a dapophet pod and heal.
achievements.summary: Use a dapophet pod to heal in From the Ashes.

steps.text: Pick a @item{dapophet pod} from a tree.
After you take damage, press I to use it.

achievements.summary: Lose the ikran race against the Sarentu in From the Ashes.

guide.context: The race is at the start of the expansion. Do not win.

steps.text: During the quest @loc{Welcome Home}, fly slowly or stop until every other rider has passed the end of the course. The achievement unlocks when the race ends.

achievements.summary: Soothe the Fireback Mastodon in the Rifts.

steps.text: Finish the quest @loc{Family Ties} to open the Rifts.
Go to the east of the Rifts near @loc{Service Outpost Bravo} and find the hiding mastodon.
Approach slowly and press E. Watch the short cutscene.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Mangkwan leaders Rakx, Zari, Ka'sem, and Wukula.

steps.text: Defeat each leader during the story. The achievement unlocks after Wukula, the last one.
